docs.summary: Lets a combined sampler built on the spot, `f(sampler2D(tex, smp))`, be passed to a user function. SPIR-V passes opaque values by pointer, so only a sampler variable can be an argument, and a constructed one is not a variable. Each such call is pointed at a copy of the function that takes the texture and the sampler separately, which are variables, and builds the combined sampler again where the body uses it. Bindless renderers build every material texture this way. When the texture or sampler was picked with `nonuniformEXT`, the copy rebuilds it with `nonuniformEXT` too, so the access stays marked non uniform inside the function. Programs without such a call come back unchanged.
